about: Reviewed FR status for the C3 Migration Studio Functions view. Requirement text is verbatim from the proposal section as extracted in the audit file. This file holds no result numbers: every figure shown on a card comes from the referenced measurements in dashboard_data.json.

functions.title: SQL Operation Identification
functions.requirement: The system must identify database query operations within the legacy PHP source code. This includes 'mysqli', 'mysql', and PDO-based queries.
functions.limitation: PDO detection is tested on fixtures only (no third-party benchmark app uses PDO); wrapper detection covers the single-parameter wrapper shape only.

functions.title: SQL Recovery
functions.requirement: SQL queries constructed using variables, string concatenation, or conditional statements must be reconstructed whenever they can be safely resolved.
functions.limitation: SQL whose text differs between if/else branches is not rebuilt by a general rule; only the Clinic query-specific templates Q014 and Q016 do this.

functions.title: Schema Analysis
functions.requirement: Database tables, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys, and relationships must be identified from the MySQL schema.
functions.limitation: Relationships are inferred from declared foreign keys only.

functions.title: Query and Column Analysis
functions.requirement: The tables and columns used by each recovered query must be identified, as well as how those columns are subsequently used within the application logic.
functions.limitation: Column use is identified per SQL statement only; how result columns are used later in the PHP application logic is not traced.

functions.title: ORM Generation
functions.requirement: The system must generate SQLAlchemy models with appropriate data types, keys, and relationships.
functions.limitation: Tables without a primary key become Core Table objects, not ORM classes. A schema-only sqlacodegen comparison (evidence/baseline) was run on all nine apps and found model parity on tables, columns, primary keys, nullability and types; foreign keys could be compared on twelve relationships in four apps only, because the other five apps declare none.

functions.title: Data Access Generation
functions.requirement: SQL operations that can be safely recovered must be converted into parameterized SQLAlchemy data access functions.
functions.limitation: Only static INNER JOIN SELECTs are converted: LEFT JOIN and implicit comma-join sites are recovered but not converted. MySQL behavioural equivalence (E1) exists for HMS only.

functions.title: Safety Checking
functions.requirement: It must be verified whether runtime values can be safely parameterized, and dynamic values used in structural positions such as table names or column names must be identified.
functions.limitation: E4 is a recording-session check with a fixed payload set (no database); runtime hostile testing on MySQL exists for HMS only.

functions.title: Safe Abstention
functions.requirement: Queries that cannot be migrated confidently or safely must be flagged for human review rather than generating incorrect code.
functions.limitation: Correct abstention is measurable only where the ground truth has non-recoverable sites; flagged sites get a reason and a stub, never generated SQL.

functions.title: Migration Support
functions.requirement: Alembic migration information required for the modernized data layer must be generated.
functions.limitation: Initial-schema revision only, no data migration.

functions.title: Traceability
functions.requirement: The original PHP file and source location must be maintained for each recovered database operation. This information can be used for review and debugging purposes.
functions.limitation: Checked by matching every evaluated site on file and line. The frozen HMS signatures.json is identical to the handoff tag (line endings aside), matches its recorded hash, and every php_site label in it is the pipeline's own label; HMS_HANDOFF.md, edited after the tag, cites the Q036 site without its include/ directory and has not been regenerated.
